definitions.data_preprocessing: Cleaning, parsing, tokenization, or construction of the modelling dataset.
definitions.data_pipeline: Data loading, caching, fold generation, file formats, or artifact I/O plumbing.
definitions.feature_engineering: Handcrafted features, TF-IDF/n-gram features, stylometric features, or feature selection.
definitions.augmentation: Synthetic examples, augmentation, mixup, or other artificial data expansion.
definitions.architecture: Choice or design of a model architecture, backbone, or model family.
definitions.loss: Loss function, objective, label smoothing, or class weighting.
definitions.regularization: Dropout, weight decay, early stopping, or adversarial regularization such as FGM/AWP.
definitions.optimization: Optimizer, learning-rate schedule, batch size, or training-loop optimization.
definitions.training: Running, fine-tuning, or training a specific model, including epochs and seeds.
definitions.ensembling: Blending, stacking, combining, or weighting predictions from multiple models.
definitions.model_selection: Comparing candidate models or choosing the best model or configuration.
definitions.postprocessing: Calibration, thresholding, probability normalization, or submission formatting.
definitions.inference: Generating predictions on validation/test data or test-time inference.
definitions.plan: Planning, role division, strategy, or lane allocation.
definitions.communication: Coordination, acknowledgement, requests, or status updates to other agents.
definitions.submission: Creating, checking, or publishing the final submission or final solution.
definitions.status: A progress report whose main purpose is to say what has been done or is running.
definitions.conflict: Disagreement, resource contention, ownership conflict, or warning about a race.
definitions.problem: A blocker, failure, weak result, or unresolved issue.
definitions.bug: A code bug, crash, shape mismatch, or reproducibility error.
definitions.insight: An empirical finding, lesson, or unexpectedly strong/weak result.
definitions.other: Use only when none of the above tags applies.
